{{# Quiz question (App\Fieldtypes\Quiz). Renders the configured answers as the control chosen in `question_fieldtype` — `radio` (default), `checkboxes`, or `select` — by delegating to the shared form-field partials so the standard wrapper conventions (label, instructions, error, aria-*, conditional visibility) and submit shape are reused rather than duplicated. Only answer labels reach the page: App\Fieldtypes\Quiz::extraRenderableFieldData() replaces the raw `options` grid with a sanitized `value => label` map, so the per-answer `is_correct` / `weighted_score` / `answer_explanation` config never appears in the public HTML (UAMS-Web/uams-statamic-archive#816). Answer order already honors `randomize_order` via the fieldtype's RandomizesOptions trait. #}} {{ if question_fieldtype == 'checkboxes' }} {{ partial:vendor/statamic/forms/fields/checkboxes }} {{ elseif question_fieldtype == 'select' }} {{ partial:vendor/statamic/forms/fields/select }} {{ else }} {{ partial:vendor/statamic/forms/fields/radio }} {{ /if }}
